sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This Physical Protection Policy defines the requirements for limiting, monitoring, and auditing physical access to facilities, equipment, and operating environments of {org_name} housing {system_name}. It protects the physical boundary of {boundary} containing Controlled Unclassified Information such as {cui_description}.

sections.heading: 2. Physical Access Control

questions.prompt: How are authorized individuals identified for physical access?
How is physical access limited to authorized individuals across systems, equipment, and operating environments?

sections.body: Authorized individuals allowed physical access are identified by {authorized_physical_users}. Physical access to organizational systems, equipment, and operating environments is strictly limited to authorized individuals through {physical_access_limits}.

sections.heading: 3. Visitor Escort and Monitoring

questions.prompt: How are visitors escorted within physical facilities?
How is visitor activity monitored during facility visits?

sections.body: Visitors entering facilities are escorted in accordance with {escort_procedures}. Visitor activity is continuously monitored using {visitor_monitoring_procedures}.

sections.heading: 4. Physical Access Audit Logging

questions.prompt: How are audit logs of physical access maintained and reviewed?

sections.body: Audit logs of physical access to facilities and sensitive areas are maintained through {physical_logging_method}.

sections.heading: 5. Control of Physical Access Devices

questions.prompt: How are physical access devices such as keys and badges identified?
How are physical access devices controlled and managed throughout their lifecycle?

sections.body: Physical access devices including keys, keycards, and badges are identified in {access_device_inventory}. Physical access devices are controlled and managed through {access_device_control}.
